html:
$RIFT is Riftn’s in-app currency. You can already use it inside Riftn. The on-chain token has yet to launch and has no official contract address or exchange listing.

Use the in-app balance for supported features such as tipping, unlocking content, rewards and Creator Studio. An exchange or external wallet is unnecessary for these uses.

Balances and existing staking badges influence the features and tiers available to your account. See the launch status page for the on-chain token release.

What it is used for:

  • Tipping creators: Send value straight to a creator on a post, short, stream or stage — instantly, globally and without a middleman skimming the transfer.
  • Purchasing content: Unlock pay-per-view uploads, token-locked posts, premium messages and creator subscriptions. The creator is paid on unlock, not 30 days later.
  • Rewards currency: x-2-earn payouts, watch rewards, bounties on published content, raffles, games and community campaigns are all denominated and paid in tokens.
  • AI generation credits: Spend tokens as credits across the AI Toolkits — image, video, audio and agent generation — instead of holding a separate subscription per tool.
  • Stores & marketplace: Buy products, digital collectables, services and Phygital NFTs from creator stores and the marketplace using one balance.
  • Free voting on community proposals.

$RIFT is a utility currency for use inside Riftn.
